extDescription.message: Extract English words from web pages with one click and automatically add them to your 不背单词 (BBDC) wordbook.

statusReady.message: Ready — click "Collect this page" or use the canvas below to upload files.
statusReady.description: Idle default state after opening the popup (issue #39: no auto-collect on open)

btnCollectPage.description: Button to explicitly collect the active tab (issue #39)

btnConfirmPush.description: Button to confirm and push collected words

pushExisting.description: Label for words already in wordbook

btnExportCsv.description: Button to export word library as CSV

btnOpenBbdc.description: Button to open 不背单词 website

statusLoggedIn.description: Login status: logged in (brand mention lives in the footer Open 不背单词 button; kept short so the header never overflows at 384px)

statusLoggedOut.description: Login status: logged out (kept short so the header never overflows at 384px)

pushRunning.description: Push in progress status, params: pushed count, total, pending count

pushPausedWithError.description: Push paused (with error), params: error message

exportedLogCount.description: Exported error log count, params: count

importingFile.description: Importing file in progress, params: filename

importParsedPending.description: Import parsed awaiting confirmation, params: filename

uploadCollectingFile.description: Upload collection in progress, params: filename

uploadCollectingFiles.description: Upload collection in progress for a multi-file batch (issue #38), params: file count

uploadCollectingPasted.description: Upload collection in progress for the pasted-text channel (issue #42)

uploadCanvasHint.message: Click to choose files, or drop files / folders

uploadCanvasPasteHint.message: Paste text or files; drop folders
uploadCanvasPasteHint.description: Upload canvas sub-hint: paste gesture and folder guidance (issue #42)

uploadSummaryFiles.description: Upload collection summary without ignored files, params: accepted file count

uploadSummaryIgnored.description: Upload collection summary with ignored categories, params: accepted count, ignored count, suffix category list

uploadIgnoredNoSuffix.description: Category label for ignored files without an extension (issue #41)

uploadReplacedBatch.description: Status note after an upload replaces the previous upload batch (issue #41)

uploadConfirmOverwrite.message: Uploading will discard the current pending batch. Continue?
uploadConfirmOverwrite.description: Confirmation before an upload discards a collect/import batch (issue #41)

uploadLimitExceeded.message: Limit exceeded: max $1 files / $2 MB; got $3 files / $4 MB
uploadLimitExceeded.description: Upload double-limit whole-batch rejection, params: max file count, max MB, actual file count, actual MB

uploadFailed.description: Upload collection failed, params: error message

uploadUnexpectedError.description: Generic failure for unexpected upload errors (code-review P1), no params

overwriteAccept.description: Inline overwrite ask: proceed with the upload, discarding the resident collect/import batch (issue #41 overwrite semantics)

overwriteCancel.description: Inline overwrite ask: cancel and keep the resident collect/import batch (issue #41 overwrite semantics)

confirmSummary.description: Confirmation page summary, params: source (Collect/Import/Upload), total, new count

errorCannotInject.message: Cannot collect from this page: chrome:// and other special pages do not support injection

errorInvalidContentResponse.message: Content script did not return a valid response

errorOnlyTextFiles.description: Only text files error, params: filename, supported extensions list

errorConfirmMergeFailed.message: Confirm merge failed (batch $1 words retained for retry): $2
errorConfirmMergeFailed.description: Confirm merge failed error, params: batch word count, error details

errorImportFailed.description: Import failed error, params: error details

errorUploadFailed.description: Upload collection failed error, params: error details

emptyHint.message: Your library is empty — collect this page or upload a file to get started.
emptyHint.description: Empty state hint shown when the word library has no words

pushProgress.description: Accessible label for the push progress bar

menuCollectPage.description: Context-menu entry to open the popup and collect the current page (http/https pages only, issue #40)

menuUploadFiles.description: Context-menu entry to open the popup straight at the upload canvas, any page (issue #40)
